GÖTTFERT 
GÖTTFERT products 
GÖTTFERT manufactures rheological testing equipment for polymers, elastomers or food, including capillary rheometers, melt flow testers, viscometers, rubber analysers and laboratory extruders.
Products 
Elastomer 
GÖTTFERT – Elastomer testing devices 
 High quality elastomer testing devices from GÖTTFERT including mooney viscosimeters, MDR moving die rheometers, RPA rubber process analysers and RCR rubber capillary rheometers. 
 FIND OUT MORE
MFR/MVR 
GÖTTFERT – Melt index testers 
 Melt flow index testers from GÖTTFERT meet the highest customer expectations. Overview of MFI (Melt flow index) devices for research, development and production. 
 FIND OUT MORE
Extension 
GÖTTFERT – Extensional rheometer 
 When characterising polymer materials in blow moulding, thermoforming, calendering, coating and spin processes, an extensional rheometer such as the RHEOTENS or HAUL-OFF from GÖTTFERT provides important information.

Advantages at a glance 
Precision and customer service make all the difference. GÖTTFERT and TeMeCo provide instruments and services on site.

No compromises when it comes to precision.
Intuitive handling 
Modern equipment and intuitive handling.

Automated systems for less variability in results and less time spent by the operator.
After-Sale-Unterstützung 
Fast response time and best support for questions and problems.
Rheological testing equipment since 1962 
GÖTTFERT Werkstoff-Prüfmaschinen GmbH was founded in 1962 by Prof. Dr Otto Göttfert. In the second generation, his son, Dr Axel Göttfert, took over as sole managing director.
On the global market, this medium-sized company is recognised as one of the leading firms in the niche sector of rheological testing equipment. The innovative rheological systems are used worldwide in laboratories as well as in production.
